title: Type Fly
description: An album title set flat and huge beside its cover. Change the record and every letter of the old title peels off the page and sails away in depth while the new one turns in from space and lands flat, crisp Geist with a serif byline. Hover or press the title and the letters under your finger lift off the page and lean toward you.
intent: One type mechanic finished to the edge: real flat glyphs that peel into 3D and land back as crisp text, on per-letter springs that can be interrupted at any moment.
